steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary; the prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Convert the published RFQ with its existing bids and participants into an auction.
Open the vendor portal as Vendor A while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the converted auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Have Vendor A revise the carried-over 100 bid to 85 and submit it.
Verify the vendor portal accepted the revised auction bid.
Return to the buyer's project page to inspect the updated ranking.
Open the buyer comparison grid and verify Vendor A appears after the revised bid.
Assert that the auction ranking reflects the revised lower bid.
